subject: Graduate Structural/Civil Engineer (Glendenning): Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello Dave,

I am applying through SEEK for the Graduate Structural/Civil Engineer role at Glendenning (job 95221380), and as you look after NSW I wanted to reach you directly.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. Before that I worked on site in the Philippines from 2019 to 2020 as a project in charge engineer and then a field engineer. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a driver licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

The advert describes shoring calculations and drawings beside an experienced engineer. My coursework covered hand calculations by the method of joints, AS 4100, AS/NZS 1170, AS 1726 and AS 1289, and this is where I want to build real design experience. I have not used Solidworks, and my AutoCAD and Civil 3D work so far is from study rather than a paid design office.

Would you be open to a short call about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.subject: Application for Graduate Structural/Civil Engineer, Glendenning (SEEK 95221380)
paragraphs: I am applying for the Graduate Structural/Civil Engineer role at ShoreWorX in Glendenning, advertised on SEEK as job 95221380. The role pairs a graduate with an experienced engineer on shoring design, calculations and drawings, with occasional site visits, which is the kind of mentored design work I am looking for.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026. The course covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, with drawings prepared and reviewed in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi (2014 to 2019). Coursework included hand calculations (equilibrium and the method of joints), AS 4100, AS/NZS 1170, and the geotechnical standards AS 1726 and AS 1289.

From April to September 2019 I was project in charge engineer on a community hall renovation in the Philippines, coordinating 10 to 15 workers each day, reviewing drawings and carrying out site inspections and quality checks. From September 2019 to February 2020 I was a field engineer on subdivision finishing works, preparing site reports, material records and progress reports and working with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.

I have not used Solidworks, and my AutoCAD and Civil 3D experience comes from study rather than a commercial design office. ShoreWorX's engineering page explains how its team designs temporary works where ground conditions vary, vehicles load the edge of an excavation or live services are in the way, and I would like to learn that work properly under supervision.

I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a driver licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am open to discussing relocation for the right role. My resume is attached and study drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

screening_answers.question: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
screening_answers.answer: Subclass 485 visa with full working rights until December 2027. Do not claim citizenship or permanent residency.

screening_answers.question: How many years' experience do you have as a Structural Civil Engineer?
screening_answers.answer: No paid structural or civil design role yet. Site engineering in the Philippines April 2019 to February 2020 (under one year), so choose the lowest band (less than 1 year).

screening_answers.question: How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
screening_answers.answer: Not on record. Marc to answer.

screening_answers.question: How many years' experience do you have as a Solidworks Draftsperson?
screening_answers.answer: None. Marc has not used Solidworks; drafting is AutoCAD, Civil 3D and Revit coursework.

screening_answers.question: Have you completed a qualification in civil engineering?
screening_answers.answer: Yes. Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Divine Word College of Legazpi, 2019) and Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design (Albright Institute, February 2026).

checklist: Open https://www.seek.com.au/job/95221380 and confirm the Graduate Structural/Civil Engineer advert is still open.
Upload Marc_Masarate_ShoreWorX_Resume.pdf and the cover letter PDF from this pack.
Answer SEEK screening: 485 to Dec 2027; structural civil experience under 1 year; Solidworks none; civil qualification Yes; notice Marc to confirm.
Do not claim Solidworks, commercial design office work or Australian site experience.
Press Applied on the tracker after the SEEK receipt arrives; only then may the prepared note to Dave Sellar be considered under the normal send checks.
notes: SEEK is the advertised route. Dave Sellar (State Manager NSW) has a published business email on the ShoreWorX team page; the email draft waits until Marc applies on SEEK.
